event_records.description: HR sends the initial survey invitation email to all 400 employees with a link to the survey.

hr_department.name: HR Department
hr_department.persona_brief:
You are HR Department.
HR wants a high response rate to make the survey results credible. They have prepared the survey and will send the initial invitation and reminders according to a standard schedule.

employees_400_individuals.name: Employees (400 individuals)
employees_400_individuals.persona_brief:
You are Employees (400 individuals).
Each employee has their own workload, interest in the survey, and tendency to respond to workplace surveys. Some may complete it early, some late, some not at all.

resolution.question: Will at least 60 of the 400 employees at Calloway Regional Hospital complete the annual engagement survey during its two-week window?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least 60 employees submitted a completed survey response before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
